findings.title: Task 2's "suite passes unchanged" fails because of an existing test
findings.description:
Task 2 replaces `PythonAdapter.metrics = frozenset(SnapshotMetric)` (`src/squadron/metrology/snapshot/python_adapter.py:105`) with an explicit set of the four metrics from slice 400. It then says "the full `tests/metrology/` suite passes unchanged". But `tests/metrology/snapshot/test_python_length.py:60` asserts `adapter.metrics == set(SnapshotMetric)`. Once the new enum members exist, that assertion fails. A junior agent will hit this and then has to choose between editing a test it was told not to touch and undoing the fix.

Task 7's later rule, "400's length tests pass … edited only for the rename", conflicts with it too. Fix: have Task 2 change that assertion to the explicit set, and add an assertion to Task 25 that `PythonAdapter.metrics` equals the full set once all eight metrics are measured.

findings.title: Commit markers are checkboxes, not plain `**Commit**:` lines
findings.description:
All 18 commit lines use `- [ ] Commit: …` (lines 46, 68, 88, 97, 115, 142, 156, 171, 183, 191, 208, 229, 246, 262, 271, 276, 283, 290).

The project's rule is "implement, then task-checker, then commit" and "never make a commit that only checks boxes". A commit line that is itself a checkbox can only be ticked after the commit happens, so it either goes unticked or needs a check-off-only commit. Change each one to a plain `**Commit**: …` line.

Where the markers sit is fine: each follows a tested implementation step, and they are neither after every task nor only at the end.

findings.title: Two failure-mode tests don't check the signal or the side effect
findings.description:
The Technical Requirements say "Failure-mode tests assert both the signal and the outcome for each row":
- **RecursionError (Task 9):** the test checks only `unparsed_files`. It doesn't check the WARNING per file that the failure-mode table lists.
- **Token ceiling (Task 11, SC 10):** the test runs at the `duplication.py` level only. The criterion's clause "its other metrics are unchanged" is never checked through an adapter.

Fix: add a `caplog` assertion to Task 9, and one line to Task 13 or Task 26 that lowers `DUPLICATION_MAX_TOKENS` and checks that file length and function length are still present.

findings.title: `tool_failed` needs a `command=` argument that duplication and coverage don't have
findings.description: Tasks 10, 21 and 23 build failures with `tool_support.tool_failed`, which requires the keyword argument `command`. Neither the duplication pass nor the Cobertura read runs a command. Without guidance, a junior agent will make up a value. Have the tasks name what to pass, for example the report path for coverage, or name the pass in a module constant.
